name: Reversing-starter electrical interlock
summary: Blocks energization of opposite-direction contactors according to their documented feedback.
description: Blocks energization of opposite-direction contactors according to their documented feedback. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Forward and reverse status” at the input and “Opposite-coil inhibit” at the output. Mechanical interlocking may also be required.
